name: RMIT University
summary: Melbourne City campus with design, business, computing and engineering degrees; most bachelor's start in February or July.

ib.text: RMIT converts each degree's Australian entry score to IB: 65% is 25 points, 70% is 27, 75% is 29, 80% is 31, 85% is 33, 90% is 35. Totals include bonus and penalty points.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Business
programmes.about: A three-year business degree where you pick a major such as Finance, Marketing, Economics, Global Business, Entrepreneurship or Business Information Systems.
programmes.ib: The 2027 guaranteed ATAR is 70, which is 27 IB points on RMIT's conversion table; international applicants are assessed on the IB table, not the ATAR.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total through RMIT's conversion of the course's ATAR (2027 guaranteed ATAR 70).

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Business: majors from Finance and Marketing to Social Impact and Digital Economy

programmes.name: Bachelor of Computer Science
programmes.about: A three-year degree in designing software, applications and systems, building programming skills and specialising in different fields of computer science.
programmes.ib: The latest ATAR was 75.10, about 29 IB points on RMIT's conversion table; international applicants are assessed on the IB table.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total through RMIT's conversion of the course's ATAR (lowest offer 75.10 in the latest intake).

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Computer Science: design software, applications and systems and specialise in fields of computer science

faculties.name: College of Business and Law
faculties.line: Business: 2027 guaranteed ATAR 70, or 27 IB points on RMIT's table.

faculties.name: STEM College
faculties.line: Computer Science: about 29 IB points. Other degrees use RMIT's ATAR-to-IB table.

faculties.name: College of Design and Social Context
faculties.line: Architectural Design is ranked on a selection task, not the IB total; school leavers cannot enter its July intake.

notes: Architectural Design is selected on a design task; for Semester 1, 2027 the direct selection task closed on 2 October 2026, and the July 2027 intake takes only applicants with a year of design study already.
RMIT had not yet published Semester 2, 2027 application dates when this was read; its page says they will be available later this year.
Fees shown are RMIT's 2027 annual fees for international students, and RMIT says fees may rise each year.
